thread.title: Listen: How Golden Is Apple's Future?

author: Home
title: Listen: How Golden Is Apple's Future?
text:
Apple Inc.'s ( AAPL ) stock is once more near record levels, pushing the tech giant closer to a monumental $1 trillion valuation .
Will its recent announcements at its big developers conference about augmented reality, digital wellness and a new iOS help get the iPhone juggernaut get there soon? We talked with TheStreet's tech columnist Eric Jhonsa and brand-new tech reporter Annie Gaus to discuss the biggest takeaways from WWDC, and the outlook for Apple's stock.
"[Apple's services and other growing businesses] can lead investors to assign a higher multiple that might be closer to some high-margin consumer brand, rather than just a tech company with a more cyclical business," Jhonsa noted.
So listen to the audiogram and make your way to the full podcast below.
